In the wide-band limit the retarded self-energy of the dot is frequency independent,
\begin{equation}
\Sigma \equiv -\frac{i\Gamma}{2} ,
\label{eq:wb}
\end{equation}
with $\Gamma>0$. It is odd under $\omega\to-\omega$,
\begin{equation}
\Sigma(-\omega) = -\Sigma(\omega) .
\label{eq:odd}
\end{equation}
